record.question: Mention the appropriate forms of communication for: (a) issuing certain types of financial sanctions and for communicating Government orders in disciplinary cases, etc. (b) obtaining the advice, views, concurrence or comments of other departments on a proposal or in seeking clarification of the existing rules, instructions, etc. (c) ensuring quick receipt of communication warranting urgent attention at the receiving end, and also for receiving an acknowledgement of the delivery. (d) making public announcement of decisions of Government in important matters of policy. (e) for sending messages in urgent and important matters, including legal and financial messages.
